'''Jiak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed above the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'', he recruited a strike team to travel to [[Zadd]] and put an end to the [[Directive 7]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
{{Quote|Moff Jiak hopes you will assist him against the renegade droids of Directive Seven.|K-4NV, to an Imperial strike force|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Renegade droids under the collective consciousness of the self-aware artificial intelligence [[Mentor]] were due to initiate [[Directive 7]], a movement that entailed the annihilation of all organics. Greatly alarmed by this, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] Jiak of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sought assistance in putting down this uprising. Through the Imperial [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[K-4NV]], Jiak contacted an Empire-aligned hero on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to travel to the [[Vaiken Spacedock|Imperial Fleet]] in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]] to receive further briefing in person.

Aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'', Jiak sent the Imperial strike force he contacted to [[Zadd]], where the final preparations for the launch of Directive 7 were being made by the Mentor's droid forces.

Ultimately, a Sith Empire victory was secured with the destruction of Mentor, and Moff Jiak expressed gratitude and relief to the Imperial strike force.
